# A tab dropped on its own pane's edge previews a split, lands nothing

## Context

Operator, 2026-10-23 ~16:48Z, his manual test of the v13.3.1 head (a 22 s screen recording): in the Workstation he moved the 100k Matrix grid into the pane with many tabs (the heavy-tabs strip), then dragged its tab to that pane's bottom dock zone; the grid stayed where it was. Several attempts, same result; *"does not look intentional to me."*

The live app (his Chrome window, Neural Link session `f2566c04…`, dev c393d9f544) carries the mechanism in its own diagnostics:

- **Console, twice** (his two attempts, 1792774125075 and 1792774130499): `DragCoordinator: a pointer drag of scale ended in no-operation although its window accepted preview:scale:heavy-tabs:edge-bottom`, thrown from `DragAffordances.onDrop` → `reportUnlanded` → `DragCoordinator.reportAbandonedGesture`.
- **`get_drag_state`:** `abandonedGestures` ×2 `{itemId: 'scale', path: 'pointer', previewId: 'preview:scale:heavy-tabs:edge-bottom', terminal: 'no-operation'}`; every cross-window claim `no-claim` (one window, the source).
- **`get_drag_trace`:** three gestures. Gesture 1 moved the grid's tab (`neo-tab-header-button-3`) from `neo-dock-tab-sortzone-2` into the heavy-tabs strip and landed (the tab is the strip's sixth from frame 8 on). Gestures 2 and 3 started in `neo-dock-tab-sortzone-3` (the heavy-tabs strip, start index 5), travelled from the strip (y ≈ 149) down into the pane's lower half and released at (993, 528) and (806, 573); the sort zone's terminal is `end from 5 to 5, noop`.
- **Recording frames 10 and 14–16:** the drop-indicator cross mid-pane and the lower half of the heavy-tabs pane tinted as the accepted preview; after each release the layout is unchanged.

Sweeps: the newest 20 open issues at 16:52Z, no equivalent (the #20022 table's remaining operator-test rows are #20009 and #19515); title search for edge / split / same-pane drops across all states: none; A2A claims of the last hour: none on this surface; Memory Core (`query_raw_memories` on the symptom): Ada's 10-22 bug-4 (the top-edge preview behind a maximized pane, #19986) and bug-9 (root wrap) are adjacent, neither is this; own open assignments: not this surface.

## The Problem

Dragging a tab onto an **edge band of its own pane** is a legitimate dock gesture: it splits the pane, the dragged item becomes a new tabs node beside the remaining tabs (the placement grammar in `PreviewProducer.mjs:34-35`: *"`edge-*` (outer bands → split the node)"*, and `Operations.splitNode` detaches the item from its tabs node before wrapping target and new node in a split, so the item's own host is a supported target). The hover agrees: `DragAffordances#previewAt` runs the producer over *"every zone, the drag's own included"* (`DragAffordances.mjs:433, 440-446`) and shows `edge-bottom` on the heavy-tabs pane.

The release disagrees. `onDrop` (`:388-428`) re-derives the preview with the drag's own node **excluded** — `zones: geometry.zones.filter(zone => zone.nodeId !== sourceNodeId)` (`:410`) — unless the pointer sits on an indicator chip. With the own pane's zones gone, no edge preview exists at the release point, `descriptor` is null (`:419`), `applyDockZoneOperation` is never called, and the release ends in `no-operation`; because the shown preview was not the own node's `tab-into` (the one exemption `reportUnlanded` makes, `:459-463`), the coordinator reports the abandoned gesture. The hover promises a split the drop refuses to perform, on every attempt, with an error only an agent reads.

The two releases were below the indicator cross (frames 14–16), so this is the inference path. Whether the chip path (`candidate.preview` → `previewToOperation` → `applyDockZoneOperation`) lands an own-host edge is for the fix to establish; `splitNode` is written to.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/dashboard/dock/interaction/DragAffordances.mjs`: `onDrop` `:388-428` (the `:410` filter, `:419` descriptor, `:427` report), `previewAt` `:440-446` (own zone included), `reportUnlanded` `:459-463` (own-zone `tab-into` exempt, own-zone edge not), `guardEmptyWrap` `:306-314` (only the single-item edge-zone wrap is guarded).
- `src/dashboard/dock/interaction/PreviewProducer.mjs`: the five-zone grammar (`:102-155`): interior → `tab-into`, outer bands → `edge-*` or `split-before`/`split-after` along the parent split's axis; the header strip carve-out keeps the top band `tab-into`.
- `src/dashboard/dock/model/Operations.mjs#splitNode` `:389-430`: `detachFromTabs(doc, itemId)` first, then a new tabs node for the item and a new split around the target; `PreviewContract.previewToOperation` supplies the edge descriptor.
- `src/manager/DragCoordinator.mjs#reportAbandonedGesture` `:375-382`: the e2e `workerErrors` gate fails a run on exactly this error, which is why the gesture has no green e2e arm today: no spec performs an own-pane edge drop.
- Sort-zone side: the in-strip reorder (`TabSortZone`) owns own-zone `tab-into`; an own-zone edge is the dock's, not the toolbar's, which is why the sort zone reports `noop` and the dock reports `no-operation`: nobody lands it.

Design authority: the producer's grammar and `splitNode` define the own-host edge split as supported; `previewAt`'s docblock makes the hover show it on purpose; the `:410` filter has no docblock saying why the release excludes the own node. The exclusion reads as a guard against the own node's `tab-into` (a reorder the toolbar lands) that swallowed the own node's edges with it.

## The Fix

`DragAffordances.mjs`, the release path: derive the drop preview over the same zones the hover used, and exclude only the own node's **interior** (`tab-into`), which the sort zone's reorder owns — not the own node's edge bands. Concretely, drop the `:410` node filter and let `previewToOperation` / `reportUnlanded` keep treating an own-node `tab-into` as the no-report reorder it already is; or filter by placement kind after producing, if the producer offers no cheaper seam. Then the shown `edge-bottom` becomes an `edge` descriptor for `splitNode` with `targetNodeId` = the own host, which detaches the item and splits the pane: the grid docks below the remaining tabs, as the preview promised.

Red-first: a unit arm over `onDrop` with a two-item tabs node and a release in its bottom band (today: `no-operation` + an abandoned gesture; after: one `splitNode` document with the item alone below the host), and a throttled e2e arm in `test/playwright/e2e/workstation/` performing the operator's gesture (drag the grid's tab from the heavy-tabs strip to the pane's lower band): the `workerErrors` gate is red on dev today for this very error, green after, and the dock topology shows a vertical split with the grid in the lower node.

## Contract Ledger Matrix

| Target Surface | Source of Authority | Proposed Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DragAffordances#onDrop` release preview | `previewAt`'s grammar (hover = release) | the release lands the preview the hover showed, own-node edges included; own-node `tab-into` stays the toolbar's reorder | an unlandable preview still reports an abandoned gesture, as today | `onDrop` / `previewAt` docblocks | AC-1, AC-2 |
| `Operations.splitNode` with `targetNodeId` = the item's own tabs node | `splitNode` `:398` (`detachFromTabs` first) | unchanged: detach, new tabs node, split | — | — | AC-1 |

## Decision Record impact

`none`: the dock grammar and operations are unchanged; the release stops contradicting the hover.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1 **Unit, red-first:** a tabs node with two items and a pointer release in its bottom edge band produces one `splitNode` document (vertical split, the dragged item alone in the trailing tabs node, the sibling kept active in the host) and no abandoned gesture; on dev today the same release ends `no-operation` with `reportAbandonedGesture` called once. Top / left / right bands likewise; the interior still reorders without a report.
- [ ] AC-2 **E2E, the operator's gesture, red-first under throttle:** drag the 100k Matrix tab from the heavy-tabs strip into the pane's lower band and release: on dev the `workerErrors` gate reds on `DragCoordinator: a pointer drag of scale ended in no-operation …`; on the head the dock topology holds a vertical split under the former heavy-tabs slot with the grid in its lower node, the five tabs above, no error.
- [ ] AC-3 **Indicator chips:** the same release on the pane's bottom chip lands the same split (the chip path and the inference path agree).
- [ ] AC-4 **Live:** the operator repeats his gesture on the merged head and the grid docks below the tabs; Undo restores the strip (his manual test, PMV).

## Out of Scope

- Changing the five-zone grammar, the header-strip carve-out or `edgeBandRatio`.
- Cross-window edge drops (a different claim path; the coordinator's claims were `no-claim` here only because one window exists).
- Making the abandoned-gesture error user-visible; the fix removes the case, the error stays the agents' gate.

## Avoided Traps

- **Hiding the own-pane edge preview instead of landing it:** would silently remove a gesture the grammar supports and VS Code users expect; the hover is right, the release is wrong.
- **Filtering by node id at release time (today's shape):** excludes the own node's edges along with its interior; the interior is the only placement the toolbar owns.
